purpose: Teach: 飛行場/プロパティ/アダルト/宇宙船/エルサレム/ミュンヘン/インスタント/イタリアン

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんが飛行場までお見送りに来てくれたぞ
lines.en: Gran, when Father was young, he used to have someone see him off at the airport.
lines.style: Slow, measured opening. Wistful gaze into memory. Quiet voice, as if retrieving something precious and distant. Slight pause before the memory unfolds. Gentle, no urgency.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: うん、お祖父ちゃんは「プロパティ」って言葉、ご存知なかったわよね、あなた?
lines.en: Yes, and Grandfather didn't know the word "property" back then, did he, dear?
lines.style: Warm, conspiratorial tone. Light, almost playful correction — not unkind. Nodding slightly as she speaks. The comfortable rhythm of someone who's told this story before, who knows him well.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんはアダルト雑誌は読まれなかったぞ
lines.en: Gran, when Father was young, he never read those adult magazines.
lines.style: Continuing the wistful reverie. Matter-of-fact, almost defiant — protecting the memory of his father's innocence. Voice steady but weighted. The faintest smile at the edges.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、宇宙船の番組をテレビでご覧になったわよね、あなた?
lines.en: Grandfather, he watched that spaceship program on television, didn't he, dear?
lines.style: Gentle teasing warmth. Her eyes bright with the memory. The lilt of someone sharing a small, private joke. A beat of affection underneath the words.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんが新聞でエルサレムの記事を読んでらしたぞ
lines.en: Gran, when Father was young, he was reading an article about Jerusalem in the newspaper.
lines.style: Precise, specific. Each detail matters to him. Quiet pride in his father's curiosity. The pace unhurried — this moment deserves time. Voice carries the weight of history.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、ミュンヘンのお話、お聞きになったわよね、あなた?
lines.en: Grandfather, he heard about Munich, didn't he? Do you remember, dear?
lines.style: Softer now. Asking rather than stating — drawing him into shared recollection. A note of genuine curiosity beneath the warmth. She's inviting him to remember with her.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんがインスタントコーヒーに驚かれたぞ
lines.en: Gran, when Father was young, he was amazed by instant coffee.
lines.style: A small smile in his voice now. The absurdity of it, the charm of it — how much the world has changed. Wistful but with warmth. Like watching someone encounter wonder for the first time.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、イタリアン料理を初めて召し上がったときの感動、覚えていらっしゃる?あなた
lines.en: Grandfather, when you had Italian food for the first time, do you remember how moved you were, dear?
lines.style: Intimate and close, as if speaking just for him. Her voice softens at the end. The question isn't really a question — she's inviting him to feel it again. A final thread of tenderness drawing them together.
